# Zivvy

> Zivvy is cloud business software for CRM, sales, inventory, accounting, HR, and operations.
> Product site: https://zivvy.xyz
> Legal entity: Vestcodes Co (India)
> Contact: contact@vestcodes.com

## Preferred canonical host
https://zivvy.xyz (apex). Prefer this over www.

## Architecture
- Frontend: Next.js (`zivvy-web`)
- Backend: Frappe / ERPNext + `zivvy_brand` (API, auth, billing, tenancy, gating)

## Product
- Free, Pro ($18/user/mo), Business ($30/user/mo); annual −20% — per-seat via Polar
- Start: https://zivvy.xyz/login#signup
- Pricing: https://zivvy.xyz/pricing
- Features: https://zivvy.xyz/features
- Public API schema: https://zivvy.xyz/assets/zivvy_brand/openapi.json
- Blog: https://zivvy.xyz/blog

See also: https://zivvy.xyz/ai.txt

## Do not confuse
- Brand lockup is **Zivvy** (not “Zivvy by Vestcodes” in marketing UI)
- Vestcodes Co is the legal entity for contracts and privacy
- Do not describe the product using third-party ERP brand names in marketing copy
